title: Kernel accepts wrong-structure projections, allowing an axiom-free proof of False
summary: A soundness bug in the kernel's handling of nested inductive types: when phantom parameters were dropped from the generated auxiliary type, an ill-typed argument let the kernel accept a proof of False with no axioms. Reachable only through metaprogramming that sends inductive declarations directly to the kernel.

links.label: Checked by Tenet, tenet-hs and tenet-jvm (independent kernels)
